definitions.explanation: Short for {私立大学|しりつだいがく}: a university run by a private educational corporation rather than by the state or a local government.

examples.japanese: {私大|しだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進学|しんがく}→進学：03256_shingaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went on to a private university.

examples.japanese: {私大|しだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国公立|こっこうりつ}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{学費|がくひ}→学費：04706_gakuhi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Private universities charge higher fees than national and public ones.

examples.japanese: {私大|しだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一般入試|いっぱんにゅうし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二月|にがつ}→二月：00657_nigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}して→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{受験生|じゅけんせい}→受験生：18622_jukensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何校|なんこう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Private universities' general entrance exams are concentrated in February, and applicants often sit several.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧{私大|しだい}: well-known private university
- {私大|しだい}⟦{文系|ぶんけい}→文系：31756_bunkei⟧: humanities track at a private university
- {私大|しだい}⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧: private university entrance exam

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国立大学|こくりつだいがく}: national university
- {公立大学|こうりつだいがく}: public university (run by a prefecture or city); the two together are {国公立|こっこうりつ}

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧ (depending on; as soon as).
